title: Transfer closed filtered-colimit preservation to arbitrary module coefficients
statement: For a closed immersion i:Z to X with X qcqs [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and every sheaf A of commutative rings, the direct-image module functor given by base-change evaluation and scalar restriction along the actual inverse-image ring unit [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] preserves colimits of every small filtered diagram shape [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-size-convention].

proof.text: For source and target module categories, the underlying abelian-sheaf functor preserves colimits and reflects isomorphisms, and therefore reflects colimits. Module direct image composed with this functor is definitionally equal to source forgetting followed by actual abelian direct image. The latter preserves filtered colimits by the abelian closed-direct-image theorem. Composition and reflection of colimits therefore prove the assertion without constructing module-colimit representatives again.

theorem proEtale_ringed_filtered_colimits {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (A : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (I : Type (u + 1)) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape I (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u + 1} (F := proEtaleBaseChange i)
      (J := ProEt.topology X) (K := ProEt.topology Z)
      (S := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj A)) (R := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Z)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj A)))
      ⟨Functor.whiskerRight
        ((proEtaleSheafAdjunction i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).unit.app A).hom
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})⟩)
